description: Every place an asset can come from, with its license verdict. Manifest items reference a source id; the license fields below are merged into the generated index. policy: allowed = may be approved; restricted = allowed with the listed conditions; blocked = never approve (kept so nobody re-researches it).

sources.name: Project code (synthesized sound and painted scenery)
sources.notes: Sounds and pictures generated by this repository's code. Items point to the code with `impl`.

sources.name: Images generated for this project (Codex built-in image_gen)
sources.license: project-owned (subject to the image tool's terms of use)
sources.notes: Generation prompts are recorded next to each set in prompts.json.

sources.name: Style reference photos supplied by the user
sources.conditions: Reference only: attach to image prompts, never place inside an output or publish.
sources.notes: Reference images the user supplied (for example style photos). Origin and rights usually unknown.

sources.name: Kenney audio packs
sources.fit: UI clicks, impacts, short music jingles. Clean game style, neutral enough for storybooks.

sources.name: Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL)
sources.fit: Real recorded instruments for storybook music: glockenspiel, xylophone, harp, recorder, ocarina, kalimba, plus cartoon percussion (flexatone, vibraslap, slapstick, ratchet, toy whistles, ocean drum). WAV 44.1/48 kHz; whole repo about 4 GB, so fetch selected instrument folders only.

sources.name: The Essential Retro Video Game Sound Effects Collection (512 sounds) by Juhani Junkala
sources.fit: 8-bit blips and jumps. Use sparingly: chiptune timbre clashes with the watercolor look.

sources.name: OpenGameArt.org, CC0-filtered submissions
sources.conditions: Only submissions whose page lists CC0. Record the page URL as origin_url on each item.
sources.fit: Cartoon one-shots: boings, pops, silly sounds, whooshes (e.g. https://opengameart.org/content/pop-sounds, https://opengameart.org/content/wierd-whooshes).

sources.name: Freesound.org
sources.conditions: Approve CC0 freely. CC-BY needs the item-level license and attribution fields filled. Never approve CC-BY-NC. Record origin_url per sound.
sources.fit: Largest pool for nature, animals, crowds and foley.

sources.name: Sonniss GDC Game Audio Bundles
sources.conditions: Use inside finished videos is fine. Do not redistribute the raw files (keep them out of any public repository) and do not use them for AI/ML training.
sources.fit: Professional nature, weather, crowd, foley, cartoon libraries. The 2026 bundle alone is about 7.5 GB; download a year's bundle only when a specific need is not covered by CC0 sources.

sources.name: Musopen public-domain recordings
sources.license: public domain (per recording; check the page)
sources.conditions: Musopen asks for credit in commercial or derived works and asks that recordings not be sold as-is. Confirm both the composition and the recording are public domain.
sources.fit: Classical pieces tied to fairy tales: Grieg Peer Gynt (Morning Mood, In the Hall of the Mountain King), Saint-Saens Carnival of the Animals, Tchaikovsky Nutcracker, Humperdinck Hansel and Gretel.

sources.name: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
sources.conditions: Credit line: "<Title>" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
sources.fit: Ready-made whimsical and children's background tracks when composing is not worth it.

sources.name: 공유마당 (Korea Copyright Commission)
sources.license: per item: 만료저작물 / 기증저작물 / CCL / KOGL
sources.conditions: Read each item's 이용조건 and copy it into the item's license field; skip items marked 비영리 or 변경금지.
sources.fit: Korean music and sounds, including traditional (국악) material for joseon-era stories.

sources.name: GeneralUser GS SoundFont by S. Christian Collins
sources.fit: A full General MIDI instrument set in one file, for playing scores through a sampler.

sources.name: MIDI.js prerendered soundfonts (FluidR3_GM, MusyngKite)
sources.conditions: Prefer FluidR3_GM (credit in the end card). Avoid MusyngKite unless share-alike is acceptable.
sources.fit: Per-instrument JS/MP3 files that load directly in a browser sampler.

sources.name: Pixabay music and sound effects
sources.conditions: Do not redistribute files standalone. Some tracks are registered with YouTube Content ID; check before publishing there.
sources.fit: Fallback for music and effects not found in CC0 sources.

sources.name: ACE-Step 1.5 (local music generation)
sources.conditions: Record prompt, seed and model revision on every generated item. Not installed or benchmarked on this machine yet.
sources.fit: Mood-based background music drafts; runs on Apple Silicon (MLX for the LM part).

sources.name: Stable Audio 3 open-weight models (Small SFX, Small, Medium)
sources.conditions: Free commercial use only while annual revenue is under USD 1M. Record prompt, seed and model revision. Not installed yet.
sources.fit: Generating a specific sound effect no library has.

sources.name: ElevenLabs Sound Effects API
sources.license: ElevenLabs terms (commercial use on paid plans)
sources.conditions: Paid plan required for commercial use; costs money per generation. No account set up.
sources.fit: High-quality one-off effects when local generation is not good enough.

sources.name: BBC Sound Effects archive
sources.notes: Personal, educational and research use only; commercial use needs a paid licence.

sources.name: HunyuanVideo-Foley (video-to-audio)
sources.notes: Would auto-score a finished video, but the license rules it out while the publishing purpose is open.

sources.name: Suno free tier
sources.notes: Paid tiers grant commercial rights but terms are changing after the 2026 Warner settlement; re-check before any paid use.
